[size=4]
[b]Q&A ([url=https://graymane.carrd.co/]Contact Information[/url])[/b][/size]

[b]"Why did you make this mod?"[/b]
People have talked about a Stardew pony mod for like, at least five years.

[b]"Why not the actual FiM characters?"[/b]
While it's not impossible to change locations, dialogue, and NPC routines, past a certain point it would be a whole new game (albeit in Stardew's engine.)
I don't have the time or energy to invest in something on the scale of Stardew, not to mention the ever-present risk of a C&D from Hasbro.
I'm already deeper in the hole than I expected to be, haha. Stardew's a [i]really big[/i] game.

[b]"Will players be Ponified, too?"[/b]
Maybe. Hopefully. To preface this, it's so daunting a task that I haven't bothered to even try yet.

This is purely speculation;

From what I can tell, most Player animations can be worked around similar to NPCs, with the size limitations simply being yielded to.
I'm not sure what the limits of/where arms are affixed, but there's a real possibility Players may be locked to one race.
(With horns and wings as cosmetics.)
In a similar vein, it's possible that 'male' & 'female' options could be replaced with 'no magic' & 'magic', since they use entirely(?) separate sprite sheets. (Likely still with horns and wings as cosmetics.)
As for color customization, I've been thinking if [i]pants[/i] would be suitable as a replacement for the default bodies (skin colors being comparably limited) or if there are issues with that, like equipment causing the Player to disappear or a lack of animations.

Anyway, not to mention that some of these ideas might not be compatible. [/size]
